Name: Magic Starry Foraging Farm
Author: CaptainWolfe11
Description:
For a long time, I've been looking for a farm map with a totally different vibe from vanilla. I didn't see one that really fit what I was looking for for my wizard character, so I revamped the base game foraging map to make it witchy and purple and magical! The architectural structure of the map is the same, with the ponds and foliage walls remaining in the same area, as well as the shrine, spouse patio, and farm teleport, and starting location of the farmhouse and water bowl.

[b]Features:[/b]

I've used the tilesheets from the mines and wizard furniture to give this map a sort of semi-cavernous grotto vibe, like it's a cave that's been exposed to the elements. There's also new animations for the water to make it look like a portal to a starry nightscape!

The map [i]sort of[/i] has seasonal variation, in that the Spring, Summer, and Fall maps are the same, but the Winter map has white grass instead of purple grass. The tilesheets I used to be the 'dirt' of the map don't have a winter variation as they are originally mine tiles. That means that in the winter, you won't have full groundcover of snow, just the white grass. I imagine that the farm being partially shielded by the cave has kept the worst of the weather out! Please see the images to get an idea of what the farm in winter looks like. (I may add variations for the other seasons in the future, if I have time!)

I also added some blue grass spawn in the lower left corner for an area ready for farm animals, and clustered a lot of the starting spawn debris in one are because I personally hate running around in the beginning to get all my wood and stone!

This is my first farm map and I'd really like to improve it and my map making skills! If anyone has suggestions or bugs, please post about them and I'll try to get to them. At the same time, I'm learning as I go along so please be patient!

[b]Requirements:[/b]

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

[b]Installation:[/b]

To install, download the mod and unzip the folder. Then drop it in your Mods folder and you're good to go! If you need help with the basics of modding, this page is great to get you started: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Modding:Player Guide/Getting Started[/url]

[b]Other Mods and Assets:[/b]

I'm using new tilesheets for the grass from [url=https://aamatniekss.itch.io/topdown-fantasy-forest]Free Topdown Fantasy - Forest - Pixelart Tileset[/url]﻿ by aamatniekss, their stuff is amazing and their permissions allowed me to modify the tileset and make it different colors for my map.

Some mods that also really look great with this map that I'm using are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18710?tab=description]Yri's Modular Retro Style Trees[/url]﻿ (not fully updated for 1.6 yet), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url]﻿ (the transparent setting really helps you see the stars in the pool!), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22687]Kath's Grass Recolour[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15913](AT) Witchy-Gothic Buildings for Alternative Textures[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186]IdaIda's Seasonal Gothic Buildings (for CP and AT)[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12439]IdaIda's Seasonal Flooring and Paths (for CP and AT)[/url]﻿.

Thank you to everyone who made those mods, aamatniekss for their great tileset, and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild/about-me?gameId=1303]Pathoschild[/url] for SMAPI and Content Patcher :)
